connectors.name: QWIIC connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers or pin-1 mark; order taken from the printed caption left to right (SDA SCL 3.3V GND), matching left-to-right for a horizontal row

uncertain: QWIIC pin order is inferred from a caption printed beneath a small photo of the connector; the photo does not show which contact carries which signal.
notes: Kit pinmap image of the assembled device. Only wiring point with labelled pins is the QWIIC connector on the battery/RTC module. LoRa, TF card and Display tables are internal GPIO assignments without physical positions; RTC note says SDA:IO18, SCL:IO09 for the RTC, not stated for QWIIC. GPIO00/GPIO03/GPIO04 arrows point at a rotary/button control, not pins. USB-C, antenna and battery holder skipped.
